EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches (2948, 2997 cm⁻¹) and a strong band at 2837 cm⁻¹ characteristic of O–CH3 symmetric stretching, consistent with two methoxy groups (GFQ-003). Bands at 1083 and 927 cm⁻¹ fit C–O–C stretching of an acetal/ether, and the very intense 733 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with a strong acetal C–O–C skeletal deformation often seen near ~730 cm⁻¹ in dimethyl acetals. Absence of OH/NH/C=O bands disfavors candidates with those functionalities. Between the ethers/acetals, the strength of the 2837 cm⁻¹ feature favors the dimethoxy acetal 2,2-dimethoxypropane (1) over mixed ethoxy/methoxy (2).
